TATA AIG Medicare Plan Review: https://joinditto.in/articles/health-insurance/tata-aig-medicare-plan-review/

TATA AIG has launched a powerful new health insurance plan called Tata AIG Medicare Select. In this video, we walk you through everything you need to know about the Tata AIG Medicare Select plan. We explain what makes Tata AIG Medicare different, what features it offers, and whether it could be the right fit for you.

TATA AIG Medicare Select is designed for individuals and families looking for robust protection. It offers unlimited restoration of your sum insured, daily cash payouts if you opt for a shared hospital room, and maternity benefits with the option to reduce the waiting period.

We start by reviewing Tata AIG as an insurer. Their claim settlement ratio stands at a solid 96 percent, their incurred claim ratio is healthy, and they maintain a strong network of over 11,000 hospitals across India. Tata AIG has consistently ranked among the more reliable private health insurers in the country.

The Tata AIG Medicare Select plan offers sum insured options ranging from five lakh rupees to three crore rupees. It covers all key hospitalization expenses including pre-hospitalization for 90 days and post-hospitalization for another 90 days. Daycare procedures, organ donor expenses, domiciliary care, and AYUSH treatments are also fully covered.

One of the major highlights of Tata AIG Medicare Select is the Restore Infinity Plus feature. This benefit allows unlimited restoration of your sum insured within the same policy year. No matter how many times you claim, your full cover is replenished again and again.

The plan also offers a daily cash benefit if you choose a twin-sharing or multi-sharing room instead of a private room. You can get Rs 1200 to Rs 1500 per day as extra benefit without affecting your claim settlement.

Tata AIG Medicare Select rewards you for staying healthy. If you complete a claim-free year, you can either opt for a fifty percent increase in your base sum insured or receive a one percent discount on your renewal premium.

We also explore the optional covers available under Tata AIG Medicare Select. These include the Consumables Cover for non-payable items like gloves and syringes, Maternity Care Benefit which can reduce the maternity waiting period from two years to one year, Infinite Advantage that pays your full hospital bill once without applying any sum insured cap, Early Access for multi-year plans allowing you to use your total cover immediately, and Room Category Select to choose any room type you prefer.

For those wanting to manage premiums, Tata AIG Medicare Select offers an Aggregate Deductible option where you can lower your premium by opting for a deductible between Rs 10,000 and Rs 1 lakh.

Tata AIG Medicare Select is a smart choice for young families planning maternity, first-time health insurance buyers, individuals in metro cities needing premium protection, and anyone looking to future-proof their health needs with strong and flexible benefits.

Choosing the right health insurance is not about just the brand or the price. It is about matching your future needs with the right product today. Tata AIG Medicare Select offers a strong combination of wide coverage, customizations, and insurer reliability.

comments.author: @ayyappanputhoor9252

comments.text: Tata AIG MediCare Select has no disease-wise sub-limits. If you choose the Valued Provider Network discount, treatment taken outside this special hospital list will attract a 30% co-pay per claim. Valued Providers are select hospitals with enhanced tie-ups, while Network Providers are the broader cashless network. Cashless treatment is available at both, but no company can guarantee cashless claims, as that depends on the reason for the claim, documents available, etc.

comments.text:
TATA AIG is definitely a well-established insurer, and their claim settlement ratio (CSR) averages around 96% (from 2021–24), which looks quite strong on paper. However, based on some observations, there have been a few inconsistencies in how the numbers reflect in real scenarios.
Also, while TATA AIG does offer some decent plans, many of them don’t come across as truly comprehensive when compared to other options in the same price range. Most of their plans often lack features like unlimited restoration, have lower bonus rates, and don’t offer add-ons that can help reduce waiting periods. That’s why we aren’t actively recommending them at the moment.
That said, if there's a specific TATA AIG plan you’re interested in, we’re happy to review it for you. Just reach out to our advisors via call or chat, and they’ll help you evaluate it in detail.

Yes, Tata Medicare Select offers unlimited restoration of the base Sum Insured within the same policy year through its Restore Infinity Plus feature.
The restored amount can be used for multiple claims, and since the policy doesn’t specify any restriction, it’s generally understood that it can apply to both same and different illnesses, as long as the claims are valid and admissible.
